extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology. Claims are bounded to source-supported structure/activity context and do not promote inferred killing pathways to direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cryptdin bactericidal activity against E. coli and S. aureus is demonstrated by virtual colony count survival/vLD assays, but the assay is phenotypic killing rather than a direct molecular target assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane permeabilization, lipid binding, intracellular target, or host-toxicity assay is converted into a direct mechanism claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Structure/activity interpretation links S. aureus killing more strongly to tertiary/quaternary structure than E. coli killing, based on linear analog comparisons and structure/self-association analyses.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: cryptdin isoforms and linear analogs, especially Crp1, Crp4, and Crp14
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper frames this as a structure-function/SAR interpretation; it does not identify a single direct cellular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Crp14 has a disulfide-stabilized alpha-defensin fold and noncanonical dimer/interface context, supported by X-ray crystallography and molecular dynamics/supplemental structural material.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural evidence supports conformation/self-association context, not direct antimicrobial target engagement.
